content.title: Code Enforcement in Woodinville
content.summary: The Code Enforcement Division in Woodinville ensures that the policies and rules set out in the Woodinville Municipal Code are enforced to maintain a functioning community. Code enforcement covers a range of issues from construction hours to urban wildlife interactions.

steps.title: File a Code Complaint
steps.text: Code complaints can be filed online through the Woodinville Works portal. This is a formal opportunity to report a Municipal Code violation occurring in the City of Woodinville.
